title: Complete exhaustive portfolio ranking under production page limits

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Feature: Exhaustive portfolio ranking tolerates production GraphQL response limits

Scenario: Inventory spans several bounded pages
  Given an account has more scores than fit in one safe GraphQL response
  When optimization ranking enumerates the portfolio
  Then it requests bounded pages until the end cursor
  And every scorecard is represented exactly once
  And the feedback analysis still uses one frozen account-wide evidence window

Scenario: A page read fails transiently
  Given one bounded inventory page fails once
  When the same page is retried
  Then ranking continues without duplicating or skipping records

Scenario: A page cannot be recovered
  Given a bounded inventory page still fails after one retry
  When ranking reports coverage
  Then the portfolio is incomplete
  And no exact priority ordering or optimization-ready target is claimed

Observed failure: the current inventory request uses a page size of 1000 and can exceed the production GraphQL response budget before the living Report reaches useful ranking content. The repair will reduce the page size, add exactly one same-page retry, preserve exhaustive coverage evidence, and fail closed.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: The outside-in page-limit specification failed against the previous implementation because all inventory requests omitted a limit and defaulted to 1000. Added a fixed 100-scorecard page limit to the existing exhaustive cursor loop; the existing one-retry and fail-closed semantics were preserved. Focused ranking/scoping validation passes (39 tests). Production-backed dogfood then completed exhaustive inventory and ranking with complete coverage across 56 scorecards, proving the bounded page path works under the real response shape. The bug remains open until the change lands.
